name: Healing Touch, Lesser
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level adept 1, bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, paladin 1, ranger 2, shaman 1, white necromancer 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude half (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

You hold your touch on the target and their wounds begin to mend. Each round that you touch a target you heal them 1d2 + 1 per two caster levels (maximum +2).

This spell cannot be used to harm undead. Each round while concentrating on the spell, you may change who you are touching for this spell.
